name: Art and Craft Practicum
description: The design education has an element of apprenticeship which this course brings out. Students would learn one form of art or craft (representative examples include pottery, pattachitra, Madhubani painting, bandhani, mask painting etc.) from an eminent artist in residence who will come to IIT to conduct this course. Understanding art/craft form an expert. History of art/craft form. Demonstration of art/craft form. Trying it out art/craft form. Small project based on art/craft from. Reflections from experiential learning.
